---
title: "Privacy & data handling"
---

## Classify the data and output

Most Biotic data are open. Some subsets are restricted or sensitive, particularly Russian-zone
and reference-fleet data, and exact positions of vulnerable species or habitats. Check the
classification and applicable IMR rules for the data and the output being produced. If
classification is unknown, keep the material local and clarify before sharing.

BAIT is a knowledge pack, not a model trained on Biotic records. Running R and DuckDB locally
keeps database operations on the machine, but **does not guarantee that information entered
into an agent, tool, log, or generated output stays on-device or is excluded from provider
retention or training**. Provider behavior depends on the product, account, settings, and tools
in use. Check current provider controls and IMR requirements before putting restricted data
into prompts or connected services. A training opt-out is not the same as a guarantee against
transmission or retention.

## Practical handling

- Keep database files outside repositories. BAIT examples and cookbook entries contain code
  and synthetic values, never real individual records or precise coordinates.
- For open data, carry out ordinary useful analysis and share results in line with its license
  and source requirements.
- For restricted, sensitive, or unknown-classification data, minimize extracts, avoid sending
  rows or sensitive positions to external providers/tools, and keep outputs local until
  sharing is authorized. Derived outputs may still reveal restricted information.
- Run dashboards locally when they contain restricted data. Use approved IMR infrastructure
  and access controls for any hosting.

## Provider settings

Menus and terms change. Review the current privacy and data-controls information for the
provider and account you use. Disable model improvement/training where required, and verify
retention and tool-transmission behavior separately. A setting that prevents training does not
necessarily prevent processing, retention, or transmission.

*Operational guidance: [`skills/biotic-privacy/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/BAIT/blob/main/skills/biotic-privacy/SKILL.md).*
